[EFFECT] Year has a clear directional effect: 2012 (coded as 1) is associated with higher predicted demand than 2011 (coded as 0), reflecting growth in bike rental use over time. Because this is a binary feature, its effect is essentially a step change between the two years rather than a gradual curve.
[IMPORTANCE] This is the third most important feature, with a moderate spread — a meaningful but not dominant influence on predictions.
[RECOMMENDATION] Focus operational planning — bike availability, rebalancing, and staffing — primarily around the hour of the day and the temperature, as these two features drive the largest swings in predicted demand by a considerable margin. Scheduling more resources during high-demand hours and warmer conditions will have the greatest impact on meeting customer needs.
